author: EDJM9
body:
Hello staff!

I would like to appeal my infractions except the one recently that occured in May. The other infractions were when i didnt care about avicus. But now i care about this server, and i would like my infractions to look neat as possible.

Thanks.
EDJM9

P.S: As you can see, most of these infractions occured in March of 2016. This is when i rejoined Avicus.
